title: FlowDoc Document Structure Database Model v0.0.1 Checklist

items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, and unknown state.
items.evidenceTarget: The database model record identifies Project Control ownership before writing structure database framing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-document-structure-database-model, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner with documentation-authority-steward and evidence-registrar responsibilities, phase target phase-flowdoc-document-structure-database-model-v0-0-1, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-document-structure-database-model-v0-0-1, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-document-structure-database-model-2026-09-04.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the database model records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused records test fails before Project Control contains the document-structure database model Work, document, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npm run test:records failed with tests/flowdoc-document-structure-database-model.test.ts because flowdoc-product-development-resumption did not yet include flowdoc-document-structure-database-model as a child Work.

items.label: Define the draft document, section, component draft, and component field table relationships.
items.evidenceTarget: The document defines document_definitions, document_drafts, draft_sections, draft_component_instances, component_definitions, component_drafts, component_fields, component_versions, and component_version_fields.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-document-structure-database-model-2026-09-04.md defines draft and component library table groups while keeping component nesting prepared but inactive.

items.label: Define document version freeze tables as full resolved structure, not delta-only truth.
items.evidenceTarget: The document defines document_versions, document_version_sections, document_version_component_instances, document_version_fields, and document_version_bindings.
items.verificationNote: The version model freezes resolved sections, section tree, component version instances, field occurrences, binding expectations, page settings, and style snapshots.

items.label: Define publication as a pointer to a frozen document version and keep cache derived.
items.evidenceTarget: The document defines document_publications as the real-use pointer and keeps any published snapshot/cache optional and derived.
items.verificationNote: Publication is a pointer to a selected DocumentVersion. The optional published snapshot/cache is not canonical truth.

items.label: Define the v0.0.1 field_types master and defer format and validation masters.
items.evidenceTarget: The document limits field_types to text, number, date, and boolean, with field_type_id on draft fields and field_type_id plus field_type_snapshot on version fields.
items.verificationNote: The model states no format_types and no validation_rule_types in v0.0.1; currency, email, phone, percent, URL, and similar details are deferred.

items.label: Exclude runtime submissions, generated files, permissions, audit, workflow, billing, integrations, and product implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: The document keeps actual submitted values and non-structure domains outside the v0.0.1 structure database model.
items.verificationNote: The out-of-scope section excludes Runtime Submission records, generated PDF files, renderer jobs, permissions, workflow, activity feed, audit, billing, integrations, dataset seeding, and SQL migrations.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused records guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npm run test:records, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
